printVsSprites.title: PRINT vs moving sprites (Phase 6.1)
printVsSprites.description: Runs 8 moving sprites and a tight loop that PRINTs many lines. Sprites should move smoothly without sticking (dirty background, buffer-only render, animation-first).

positionSync.title: Position sync load test
positionSync.description: Runs 8 simultaneous MOVE actions. Positions and isActive are written to a shared buffer every frame (no postMessage). Worker reads for XPOS/YPOS and MOVE(n).
